title: Parameter Learning in Active Inference via Variational Message Passing
abstract: arXiv:2610.30899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Active inference casts perception, learning and planning as variational inference, where the Expected Free Energy (EFE) defines the planning objective. Recent work showed that EFE minimization can be written as Variational Free Energy (VFE) minimization on a generative model augmented with epistemic priors, and that the resulting entropy-corrected objective is minimized by sum-product message passing (SP-MP) on modified factor functions. These formulations treat model uncertainty as inference over a finite set of known models. We extend them to planning during learning, where beliefs over the observation and transition parameters $\theta_A$, $\theta_B$ are Dirichlet priors. Closed-form Dirichlet updates are usually obtained by a structured mean-field factorization between parameters and states, but under exactly that factorization the information-gain corrections vanish. translated_title: 基于变分消息传递的主动推理参数学习
translated_abstract: 主动推理将感知、学习和规划统一表述为变分推断，其中期望自由能（EFE）定义了规划目标。近期研究表明，EFE最小化可以等价地写作在带有认知先验的增强生成模型上进行变分自由能（VFE）最小化，并且所得的熵校正目标可以通过在修改后的因子函数上执行和积消息传递（SP-MP）来最小化。这些公式将模型不确定性视为对有限个已知模型的推断。本文将其扩展到学习过程中的规划，其中对观测参数和转移参数 $\theta_A$、$\theta_B$ 的信念采用狄利克雷先验表示。闭式狄利克雷更新通常通过参数与状态之间的结构化平均场分解来获得，但恰恰在这种分解下，信息增益校正项会消失。我们通过为每个因子赋予独立的参数先验来解决这一问题……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将主动推理中的期望自由能最小化统一到变分消息传递框架下，实现了基于狄利克雷先验的在线参数学习与规划的融合，并通过为每个因子分配独立参数先验解决了传统平均场分解下信息增益校正消失的关键难题。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies expected free energy minimization in active inference within a variational message passing framework, enabling planning during learning with Dirichlet priors over model parameters, and resolves the vanishing information-gain corrections under standard mean-field factorization by assigning each factor its own parameter prior.
